name: Mary Godwin
source: Chief of the Kukai Foundation's Strategy Division. She supports Jr. and Gaignun, and commands the Durandal along with her older sister Shelly. Although she was born in Miltia, she speaks with an unknown planetary accent. She is the life of the party within the Foundation. Her full name is Mary Godwin. She adopted that surname after being rescued by the Foundation.
